hints.title: Joining Users with Transactions
hints.text: Join Users with Transactions on account to associate each user with their deposits and transfers.

hints.title: Calculating Account Balance
hints.text: group by user name and compute the total balance using sum(amount).

hints.title: Filtering Qualifying Balances
hints.text: filter in having where sum(amount) strictly exceeds 10000.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT u.name, SUM(t.amount) AS balance
FROM Users u
JOIN Transactions t ON u.account = t.account
GROUP BY u.name, u.account
HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 10000;
```

import pandas as pd

def account_summary(users: pd.DataFrame, transactions: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    merged = users.merge(transactions, on='account')
    balances = merged.groupby(['name', 'account'])['amount'].sum().reset_index()
    res = balances[balances['amount'] > 10000].rename(columns={'amount': 'balance'})
    return res[['name', 'balance']]
